relations.subject: Henrik Samuel Nyberg
relations.evidence: When he was 19, he moved to Uppsala to undertake university courses. There, he studied from Classical languages to Sanskrit and to the Semitic idioms.

relations.subject: Henrik Samuel Nyberg
relations.evidence: He taught at the Fjellstedt School and Uppsala University.
